segments.title: Where was Earth's HOTTEST temperature recorded?
segments.say: Where was Earth's hottest temperature ever recorded? Sahara, Death Valley, or the Australian Outback? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: Death Valley!
segments.say: Death Valley, California! One hundred thirty-four degrees, back in nineteen thirteen.

segments.title: The GROUND hit 201°F
segments.say: And one day, the ground itself hit two hundred and one degrees.

segments.title: Under 2 inches of rain a year
segments.say: It gets less than two inches of rain a year.

segments.title: Source: National Park Service
segments.say: That's the official record, from the National Park Service.
Follow for Guess It number 26 tonight.
